questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
The brave knight set out to vanquish the fearsome dragon and protect the kingdomfrom its menace.
questions.solution:
A) Vanquish (verb)– To defeat thoroughly, conquer, overcome, subdue. हराना
Antonym: Liberate (verb)– To set free, release, free, emancipate. मुक्त करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Upright
questions.solution:
B)Upright(adjective) – Honest, honorable, moral, righteous, having strong moral principles. ईमानदार
Antonym:Immoral(adjective) – Not conforming to accepted standards of morality, unethical, wicked. अनैतिक

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
The arrival of spring brings an ebullient feeling as flowers bloom and the weather warms
questions.solution:
D)Ebullient(adjective) – Cheerful and full of energy, exuberant, buoyant, lively. उत्साही
Antonym: Weary(adjective) – Feeling or showing tiredness, especially as a result of excessive exertion or lack of sleep, exhausted, fatigued. थका हुआ

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Tight
questions.solution: B)Tight(adjective) – Firmly held or fixed in position, not loose, taut, rigid. कसा हुआAntonym:Slack(adjective) – Not tight, loose, relaxed, lax. ढीला

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.
The woman in the crowd broke down in hysterics
questions.solution:
B) Hysterics(noun) – A state of uncontrollable laughter, crying, or extreme emotional outburst. उन्माद/ अनियंत्रित व्यवहार
Antonym:Calm(adjective) – Not showing or feeling nervousness, anger, or other strong emotions, serene, tranquil. शांत

questions.question:
In the question four alternatives are given for the underlined word in the sentence. Choose the alternative which best expresses the opposite meaning of the word.
We embraced each other overjoyed at our success, then I took photograph of Tenzing holding aloft the flags of Great Britain, Nepal, the United Nations and India.”
questions.solution:
D)Embraced(verb) – To hold someone closely in one's arms, especially as a sign of affection. गले लगाना
Antonym:Junked(verb) – To discard or get rid of something as useless or worthless. फेंक देना
Limited(adjective) – Restricted in size, amount, or extent; few, small, or short. सीमित
Cradled(verb) – To hold gently and protectively, especially a baby. गोद में लेना
Contained(verb) – To hold or have within; to control or restrain. शामिल करना, सीमित करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word from the given options.
The new government allowed all the corrupt ministers to feel the sufficiency of money by banning the specific currency
questions.solution:
B) Sufficiency(noun) – The condition or quality of being adequate or sufficient. पर्याप्तता
Antonym:Dearth(noun) – A scarcity or lack of something. अभाव

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
Her sarcastic comment earned a few chuckles from the audience, who understood the irony in her words
questions.solution:
D)Courteous(adjective) – Polite, respectful, considerate in manner. विनम्र
ANTONYM:Sarcastic(adjective) – Using irony to mock or convey contempt, scornful, ironic. व्यंग्यपूर्ण /तानेभरा

questions.question:
Select the word from the sentence below, which is an antonym for the word ‘dishearten’
Many of the world’s greatest art pieces are encouraged by kings and are inspired by nature and society
questions.solution:
A)Dishearten(verb) – To cause someone to lose determination or confidence, discourage, depress. निराश करना
Antonym:Encouraged(verb) – To give support, confidence, or hope to someone, to inspire with courage or confidence. प्रोत्साहित करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
Recession fettered the company from any further investments.
questions.solution:
D) Fettered(verb) – Restrained, confined, shackled, limited.बाधित
Antonym:Liberated(verb) – Set free, released, unshackled, unrestrained.मुक्त

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
Her behaviour was consistent even in challenging situations
questions.solution:
D)Consistent(adjective) – Acting or done in the same way over time, especially so as to be fair or accurate, steady, stable. सुसंगत
Antonym:Unpredictable(adjective) – Not able to be predicted; changeable, erratic, inconsistent. अप्रत्याशित

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
The reports of the medical tests done are now accessible on phone.
questions.solution:
C) Accessible(adjective) – Easy to approach, reach, enter, or use. उपलब्ध
Antonym:Restricted(adjective) – Limited in extent, number, scope, or action. प्रतिबंधित

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Cowardice
questions.solution:
A)Cowardice(noun) – Lack of courage, fearfulness, timidity, faint-heartedness. कायरता
Antonym:Boldness(noun) – Willingness to take risks and act innovatively, confidence, courage, bravery. साहस

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
The artist's abstract painting was enigmatic to the viewers
questions.solution:
C)Enigmatic(adjective) – Difficult to interpret or understand; mysterious. रहस्यमय
Antonym:Clear(adjective) – Easy to understand; free from ambiguity. स्पष्ट

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.
The teacher praised the student for his diligent work and consistent effort.
questions.solution:
C)Diligent(adjective) – Hardworking, industrious, assiduous, careful, meticulous, attentive. परिश्रमी
Antonym:Lazy(adjective) – Unwilling to work or use energy, idle, indolent, sluggish. आलसी

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Pitiable
questions.solution:
B)Pitiable(adjective) – Deserving or arousing pity, pathetic, pitiful, woeful. दया योग्य
Antonym:Pleasant(adjective) – Giving a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment, agreeable, delightful, enjoyable. सुखद

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Quaint
questions.solution:
C)Quaint(adjective) – Attractively unusual or old-fashioned. विचित्र
Antonym: Ordinary(adjective) – With no special or distinctive features; normal, common, usual. सामान्य

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Languid
questions.solution:
D)Languid(adjective) – Lacking energy or enthusiasm, sluggish, lethargic, listless. सुस्त
Antonym:Energetic(adjective) – Showing or involving great activity or vitality, active, lively, vigorous. ऊर्जावान

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Suspend
questions.solution:
D) Suspend(verb) – to temporarily stop or delay something, halt, pause, interrupt.स्थगित करना
Antonym: Resume(verb) – to begin again or continue after a pause or interruption, restart, recommence.फिर से शुरू करना

questions.question: What is the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘fluctuate’?
questions.solution:
A) Fluctuate(verb) – To change or cause to change position constantly, be or make unstable; to rise and fall irregularly.परिवर्तनशीलहोना
Antonym:Stabilise(verb) – To make or become unlikely to change, fail, or decline; to make stable.स्थिरकरना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Accolade
questions.solution:
A)Accolade(noun) – An award or privilege granted as a special honor or as an acknowledgment of merit. प्रशंसा
Antonym:Criticism(noun) – The expression of disapproval of someone or something based on perceived faults or mistakes. आलोचना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
Maria thinks the animals that live in freedom have a sad look in their eyes
questions.solution:
D)Freedom(noun) – The power or right to act, speak, or think as one wants without hindrance or restraint. स्वतंत्रता
Antonym: Captivity(noun) – The condition of being imprisoned or confined. बंदी

questions.question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
The door was ajar and a faint wisp of smoke floated through it
questions.solution:
B)Wisp(noun) – a small, thin, or delicate piece or amount of something, often referring to smoke, hair, or similar substances. पतली धार, हल्की रेखा
Antonym:Lot(noun) – a large amount or quantity of something, usually implying a substantial, significant quantity. बहुत बड़ी मात्रा
